articles.title: Gol suspende voos entre Campina Grande e Salvador em 2027 | G1
articles.standfirst: Companhia aérea cita alta no preço do combustível de aviação para justificar mudanças na malha aérea. Passageiros podem solicitar remarcação, crédito ou reembolso.
articles.summary: Gol suspende voos entre Campina Grande e Salvador devido à alta do combustível; passageiros podem solicitar reembolso ou remarcação de passagens.
articles.body:
Gol suspende voos diretos entre Campina Grande e Salvador a partir de fevereiro de 2027 — Foto: Ana Clara Marinho/TV Globo

A companhia aérea Gol vai suspender a rota entre Campina Grande , na Paraíba, e Salvador , na Bahia, a partir do mês de fevereiro de 2027.

A decisão faz parte de uma reestruturação da malha aérea da empresa, que prevê a redução ou suspensão de voos em alguns trechos diante da alta no preço do combustível de aviação.

De acordo com dados da Aena Brasil, empresa que administra o Aeroporto de Campina Grande, com a suspensão dos voos para Salvador, a companhia aérea Gol deixa de operar no aeroporto.

Em nota enviada ao g1 , a Gol informou que os aumentos sucessivos no preço do querosene de aviação (QAV) motivaram os ajustes. Segundo a empresa, o combustível dobrou de preço e representa cerca de 40% dos custos operacionais da companhia.

A empresa também afirmou que o planejamento da malha aérea é um processo contínuo e que as mudanças são feitas de acordo com as necessidades da operação, sem priorização ou distinção entre regiões. A Gol acrescentou que continuará oferecendo alternativas de conectividade aos passageiros por meio de voos com conexão e de parcerias com outras companhias aéreas.

Como solicitar reembolso ou remarcar a passagem

Os passageiros que compraram passagens diretamente com a Gol podem solicitar remarcação, crédito ou reembolso pela Central de Atendimento, nos seguintes telefones:

Quem comprou bilhetes utilizando milhas deve gerenciar a reserva diretamente com a Smiles. Os contatos são:

Clientes Smiles ou categoria Prata: 0300 115 7001

Clientes Magno: WhatsApp +55 11 99182-4233, com atendimento 24 horas.

Já os passageiros que adquiriram passagens por meio de agências de viagens devem entrar em contato diretamente com a empresa responsável pela compra para resolver questões relacionadas à reserva.

articles.title: Indignación en el Sevilla: "Muchas ganas de tiempo de revisión..."
articles.standfirst: García Plaza, Kike Salas y Juan Iglesias protestaron mientras que el club puso varios tuits institulacional: González Fuertes también consideró que era roja y el club cargó contra Movistar Plus+ en sus redes
articles.summary: García Plaza, Kike Salas y Juan Iglesias protestaron mientras que el club puso varios tuits institulacional: González Fuertes también consideró que era roja y el club cargó contra Movistar Plus+ en sus redes
articles.body: El Sevilla salió del Bernabéu con una derrota por 4-1 y una indignación que se extendió desde el césped hasta la sala de prensa y sus canales oficiales. Luis García Plaza reclamó la expulsión de Arda Güler por su acción sobre Peque y señaló directamente al VAR. Kike Salas y Juan Iglesias compartieron esa valoración, mientras el club acompañó las protestas con varios mensajes en X dirigidos también a Movistar Plus+ por las imágenes de las jugadas discutidas. La acción entre Güler y Peque, antes del primer gol del futbolista turco, concentró buena parte del enfado visitante. El madridista no fue amonestado y el árbitro no acudió al monitor. El Sevilla lo describió así en su cuenta oficial: “Claro codazo de Güler sobre Peque que se salda con amarilla para Huijsen y Félix”. El defensa madridista fue amonestado tras tirar del brazo a Peque para levantarlo y el sevillista, por protestar. La reclamación encontró respaldo en el análisis de Pablo González Fuertes en el programa 'Marcador' de Radio MARCA. “Realizando una labor de VAR casera puedo asegurar que existe contacto violento. Hay provocación de Peque y respuesta del turco. Golpea en el pecho con fuerza y esa acción tuvo que ser castigada con tarjeta roja”, sostuvo el analista arbitral. Su valoración fue distinta sobre la otra gran protesta sevillista, la posible falta de Konaté sobre Robbie Ure antes del primer tanto de Mbappé, que supuso el 2-0. “No hay una imagen clara de un posible agarrón del defensa del Real Madrid”, afirmó González Fuertes. El malestar del vestuario ya se había hecho público durante el descanso. Kike Salas atendió a Movistar y apuntó a la acción entre Güler y Peque: “Teníamos el partido controlado pero esa acción viene de un codazo que parece que es expulsión clara, pero ahí no podemos entrar. Esos detalles marcan la diferencia”. El central explicó que se apoyaba en lo que le había trasladado su compañero, aunque todavía tenía pendiente revisar las imágenes. “Peque dice que le da un codazo y él no se va a tirar al suelo y a pedir las asistencias, confío en mi jugador, ahora lo miraré, no ha intervenido ni siquiera para verlo. Dos detalles que han tenido ellos han marcado la diferencia”, señaló. Después del encuentro, García Plaza situó esa misma jugada en el centro de su comparecencia. “Hay un partido que es once contra once, pero nos han privado de jugarlo. En LaLiga juegas partidos en superioridad o en inferioridad, hoy tendríamos que haberlo jugado en superioridad desde el minuto 25. Nos han privado de jugar un partido de 10 contra 11. A partir de ahí, no voy a hablar del partido”, afirmó. El entrenador reconoció el merecimiento del triunfo blanco con igualdad numérica, pero insistió en que, a su juicio, el encuentro debía haberse desarrollado en otras condiciones. “En el descanso Peque estaba diciendo que le había pegado y la he visto y es verdad. Es el resumen del partido. Con once contra once, nada que decir, el Madrid ha merecido ganar. Pero hay otro partido que no se puede ver”, explicó. García Plaza puso el foco en Cuadra Fernández, encargado del VAR, por encima de Busquets Ferrer. “Es una jugada de VAR cien por cien. Se equivocan y ya está”, manifestó. “Habría que hablar con la persona del VAR más que con el árbitro, que puede que no la vea. Además, con Barça, Madrid y Atlético hay muchas más cámaras en el campo, de ahí que para mí sea una jugada más de VAR. Es una jugada muy clara y, además, una agresión”, sostuvo. También dejó otro reproche: “Los que más se quejan son los que menos se tendrían que quejar”. El club difundió igualmente un vídeo del técnico ante sus medios oficiales con una frase que resumía su protesta: “Había que jugar 10 contra 11...”. La queja institucional también se dirigió hacia la retransmisión. Movistar Plus+ Deportes había compartido el gol de Mbappé con este texto: “Tienen que colgarlo en el Louvre. Golazo de poesía pura de Mbappé contra el Sevilla FC”. El Sevilla respondió con una petición: “¿Podéis rebobinar 18 segundos? Nos gustaría ver la jugada entera”. El mensaje aludía a la acción entre Konaté y Ure que los visitantes reclamaron como falta. A esa respuesta añadió otra, también sobre la publicación del gol: “Con el Prado tan cerca y os vais al que es famoso por los robos...”. Una réplica que utilizaba la referencia al museo parisino para expresar su enfado. Cuando Movistar Plus+ Deportes publicó un vídeo de la disputa entre Konaté y Ure, el club volvió a intervenir. “Vaya... ¡Más de tres horas después! Habéis sido más rápidos en X que en la retransmisión”, escribió, acompañando su reproche con varios emoticonos. Juan Iglesias también cuestionó las imágenes ofrecidas de esa jugada. “Hemos estado en el partido, lo hemos intentado. Se ha decidido por decisiones que se han tomado”, declaró tras el encuentro. “La acción de Peque es una agresión, lo hemos visto en el descanso. Y en otro gol de ellos es una falta a Robbie que no han repetido en televisión. Sabíamos a lo que veníamos. Hacer autocrítica también, pero hay decisiones que no han salido de nuestra parte y eso hay que valorarlo también”, añadió. El lateral cerró sus declaraciones con una crítica al trato arbitral: “Muchas veces no se puede hablar con ellos, no te lo permiten: que te vayas, que te saco tarjeta... es lo fácil siempre. Pero veníamos aquí y sabíamos cómo iba a ser todo”. García Plaza, por su parte, insistió en que reclamar la expulsión no equivalía a dar por seguro un resultado diferente. “El Madrid es capaz de ganarte con 10 porque son muy buenos, pero nos han privado de esa situación. Es otro partido que se tendría que haber jugado, de 11 contra 10 durante mucho tiempo. Era un partido que nos tocaba haber jugado en superioridad”, defendió. El Sevilla no rebaja el tono de sus protestas tras la derrota por 4-1 ante el Real Madrid en el Bernabéu. El club hispalense ha publicado en la mañana de este lunes un nuevo mensaje en sus redes sociales para insistir en su malestar con la actuación arbitral. "Muchas ganas de tiempo de revisión", ha escrito en X, acompañando la frase con los emoticonos de un cronómetro y unas palomitas. Un nuevo dardo con el que los nervionenses reclaman una revisión más exhaustiva de las acciones polémicas del encuentro, especialmente el posible codazo de Arda Güler sobre Peque que, a su juicio, debió terminar con la expulsión del futbolista madridista. El Sevilla salió del Bernabéu con una derrota por 4-1 y una indignación que se extendió desde el césped hasta la sala de prensa y sus canales oficiales. Kike Salas y Juan Iglesias compartieron esa valoración, mientras el club acompañó las protestas con varios mensajes en X dirigidos también a Movistar Plus+ por las imágenes de las jugadas discutidas.

articles.title: Jutglà: “Estoy muy feliz por el equipo, nos lo merecíamos”
articles.standfirst: El delantero sumó su segundo tanto de la temporada ante el Alavés
articles.summary: El delantero sumó su segundo tanto de la temporada ante el Alavés
articles.body: Ferran Jutglà marcó el tanto que abrió el marcador para la victoria del Celta ante el Alavés, segundo tanto del delantero en la presente temporada: “Muy feliz por el equipo y porque nos lo merecíamos, nos fuimos muy contentos”. Se siente orgulloso del rendimiento colectivo: “El esfuerzo del equipo fue espectacular, la intensidad que le metimos, el ritmo, la intención, los noventa minutos peleando. Nos pusimos 2-0, se nos puso el partido bronco con el 2-1 y arrimamos el hombro y sacamos los tres puntos que eran muy importantes”. Un triunfo que entiende debe servir para subir el ánimo: “Veníamos haciendo las cosas bien pero está claro que las victorias te dan ese ánimo y esos puntos para pelear por cosas bonitas. Estamos contentos por eso y ahora a recuperarnos porque tenemos un partido bonito el jueves en Glasgow". Las lesiones de Borja Iglesias y Pablo Durán están cargando de minutos al delantero, que en este arranque de temporada ha podido rotar menos, disputando 680 minutos en los 11 partidos oficiales disputados, sin perderse ningún encuentro y siendo titular en 9 de ellos.

articles.title: ¡El Real Murcia-Real Zaragoza ganó a toda la Liga Hypermotion!
articles.standfirst: Los 21.497 espectadores que acudieron al encuentro superaron a los registros de los partidos de la jornada de la segunda categoría del fútbol español
articles.summary: Los 21.497 espectadores que acudieron al encuentro superaron a los registros de los partidos de la jornada de la segunda categoría del fútbol español
articles.body: En el acta figura que se disputó un partido de Primera RFEF, pero un Real Murcia-Real Zaragoza en la Nueva Condomina es mucho más. La estadística, un adorno otras veces, no miente cuando sitúa el encuentro con una asistencia de 21.497 espectadores. Una asistencia récord en Murcia en la temporada y superior a la exhibida por los diez partidos de la jornada de Segunda, la Liga Hypermotion. El Real Zaragoza es un cartel atractivo en cualquier localidad que visite en esta incursión en la tercera categoría del fútbol español. Si se le une a eso la visita a otro grande, con un gran estadio, la expectación queda asegurada. La categoría de plata no pudo competir con el registro murciano. El encuentro de El Molinón fue el que más se acercó al duelo de Murcia. El Sporting-Albacete lo presenciaron 20.134 aficionados; después se sitúa en la escala el Valladolid-Eldense, que reunió a 17.512 aficionados. El bronce se lo quedó en el podio el derbi andaluz Granada-Cádiz, con 15.422 seguidores. En el mismo escalón quedó situado el Las Palmas-Castellón, con 15.054 asistentes. En los demás partidos el único que superó los diez mil aficionados fue el Leganés-Córdoba, que sumó una entrada de 11.102 aficionados. Ya muy por debajo quedan el Girona-Andorra (9.500), el Burgos-Sabadell (7.945), el Eibar-Mallorca (5.078), el Ceuta-Oviedo (1.582) y el Real Sociedad B-Almería (780). El partido de Murcia tuvo más chicha en la grada, Carlos Alcaraz incluido, que en el césped. Ambos equipos llegaban con el liderato en el cogote, pero el empate final sin goles abrió las puertas de la cima de la clasificación al Villarreal B. El Real Murcia no juega en Segunda desde la 2013-14 y su última aventura en Primera se atrasa hasta la campaña 2007-08. Por su parte, el Real Zaragoza comparte crisis. El año pasada descendió a Primera RFEF y no juega en Primera desde la 2012-13.

articles.title: "Nos ofrecieron a De Gea gratis y 'A-Cap' dijo: “Es un portero de la vieja escuela, no deberíamos ficharlo"
articles.standfirst: Andrés Blázquez, CEO del Genoa, denuncia los "millones perdidos" por la batalla legal que existía sobre la propiedad del club
articles.summary: Andrés Blázquez, CEO del Genoa, denuncia los "millones perdidos" por la batalla legal que existía sobre la propiedad del club
articles.body: El Genoa de Daniele de Rossi, antepenúltimo en Serie A con cuatro puntos de 21 posibles, asegura "mirar hacia una nueva etapa" después de lograr "una importante victoria judicial tras 18 meses de litigios con A-Cap" sobre la situación accionarial del club. Así, al menos, lo ha asegurado el español Andrés Blázquez, CEO del club, en una entrevista con 'Flashscore': "A-Cap [conserva una participación del 22%] no tiene ninguna participación en la gestión del Genoa. Estamos aliviados; sentimos que se nos ha dado la razón. Şucu asumió un riesgo enorme al entrar cuando la empresa estaba cerca de la bancarrota". Una batalla legal que le ha costado al Genoa "millones de euros en honorarios legales"... y dejar escapar grandes oportunidades de mercado. "Teníamos la opción de fichar a Djed Spence por 7 millones de euros y la rechazaron", asegura Blázquez al referirse al ahora jugador del Inter, que jugó cedido en el Genoa en la 2024-25. Más explícito, si cabe, se mostró al referirse al posible fichaje de David de Gea, portero de la Fiorentina: "Nos ofrecieron ficharle gratis y, una vez más, creo que A-Cap dijo: “Es un portero de la vieja escuela; no deberíamos ficharlo”. Otro de los que, según Andrés Blázquez, dejaron escapar por culpa de esa 'bicefalía' en los despachos fue Mason Greenwood: "Diría que probablemente perdimos más de 70 u 80 millones de euros en valor de jugadores por tener a personas ajenas al mundo del fútbol tomando decisiones". El CEO español del Genoa, sin embargo, confía en que ahora, poco a poco, puedan remontar con una estrategia clara: "Les garantizo que esa situación no se habría producido si el señor Şucu hubiera estado al mando en aquel momento".

articles.title: Vitinha: "Creo que PSG y Barça con el Bayern son los mejores ahora de Europa"
articles.standfirst: El jugador del PSG asegura que no tiene miedo a Lamine pero reconoce que es increíble lo que está haciendo
articles.summary: El jugador del PSG asegura que no tiene miedo a Lamine pero reconoce que es increíble lo que está haciendo
articles.body: Vitinha ha sido el jugador del PSG que ha ofrecido junto a Luis Enrique la rueda de prensa previa al partido de mañana ante el Barcelona en París. Una final anticipada: "estoy en un buen momento a nivel individual pero no creo que sea porque haya marcado. Es pronto para decir que este duelo es una final anticipada. La verdad de ahora no es la de mayo, pero siempre es un gran partido. Son dos de los mejores equipos de Europa, diría con el Bayern, y siempre hay ganar de jugar estos partidos". El estado de Kvaratskhelia: Siempre hay altos y bajos, en todos. Lo que pasa con uno o dos jugadores no es para toda la temporada. Todos vamos a estar al mejor nivel mañana, eso espero". Lamine Yamal: "Miedo no, es verdad que es uno de los mejores y lo que está haciendo ahora es increíble. Es verdad que es especial, pero es injusto solo hablar de él en el Barça. Hay sobre todo un gran equipo". El partido no es una final: "Hay muchas ganas de jugar y mostrar en qué nivel estamos nosotros y el Barça, pero no es una final". Cómo frenar el medio campo del Barça: "Veremos, hay que hacerlo muy bien y nos van a presionar. Ante el City en el primer tiempo lo hemos hecho muy bien. veremos". La aportación de Dembélé: "Hace tiempo que es un líder, en este tipo de partidos nos hace más fuertes por lo que aporta, es único. Sabemos todos lo que es capaz de hacer". Si el Barça es el mejor medio campo del mundo: "Vamos a ver quién va a controlar más el partido, pero son dos equipos que quieren tener ese control pero es complicado cuando hay dos equipos que presionan mucho. Son dos grandes equipos en el medio campo y en general". Su paso por París: "siempre puedo mejorar, como me dice Luis Enrique, pero he evolucionado mucho y estoy orgulloso de lo que estamos haciendo en París. Es mi quinto año pero espero que sigamos así, ganando". El Balón de Oro: "me parece más justo que lo gane un jugador del PSG, pero es verdad que hay mucha competencia y muchos buenos jugadores. Me parece que Kane, Kylian, Lamine, Olise... pero lo más justo para mí sería un parisino".

articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo leads Ballon d’Or of All Time (B.O.A.T.) fan vote by a landslide ahead of Messi and 10 other winners
articles.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo's iconic 2008 season gains renewed recognition in the Ballon d'Or B.O.A.T. fan vote, where he leads with a remarkable 62% of the votes, showcasing his legacy against competitors like Lionel Messi and other football legends. Vote now and see why his campaign is considered the greatest in history!
articles.body: Cristiano Ronaldo has not appeared on the Ballon d’Or shortlist since 2022, but his place in the award’s history is receiving fresh attention through a new fan vote. The Al-Nassr forward is currently leading the official Ballon d’Or B.O.A.T. competition, with supporters backing his 2008 Manchester United campaign as the greatest winning season in the award’s history. The poll gives fans another way to revisit the season that first put Ronaldo among football’s defining names.What is the Ballon d’Or B.O.A.T. fan vote?The official Ballon d’Or platform launched the B.O.A.T. — Ballon d’Or Of All Time— competition in early October, inviting supporters to choose the finest individual season among 10 players who have won the trophy at least twice. Rather than asking fans to select their favourite footballer, the poll focuses on what each candidate achieved during a particular Ballon d’Or-winning campaign.The ten contenders are Lionel Messi, Cristiano Ronaldo, Ronaldo Nazário, Marco van Basten, Michel Platini, Karl-Heinz Rummenigge, Kevin Keegan, Franz Beckenbauer, Johan Cruyff and Alfredo Di Stéfano.At the time of writing, Ronaldo’s 2008 season was reportedly leading with 62 per cent of the votes, while Messi’s 2012 campaign had received 13 per cent. The result remains provisional, with voting scheduled to close at midnight on October 27 and the final results expected on October 28.There is also a paid element to the contest, with each vote costing €1 and supporters allowed to vote repeatedly, including for the same player. That format has prompted questions about how much the leaderboard reflects football judgement, but Ronaldo’s commanding early lead has nevertheless brought his first Ballon d’Or season back into focus.Why Ronaldo’s 2008 season remains so memorableRonaldo won his first Ballon d’Or in 2008 while playing for Manchester United, after a campaign in which he scored 42 goals across all competitions and helped the club win both the Premier League and the Champions League.He also scored in the Champions League final against Chelsea, although United ultimately needed a penalty shootout to secure the European title. By then, the winger Sir Alex Ferguson had signed from Sporting CP had developed into one of the most decisive players in world football.That season marked the beginning of Ronaldo’s long run among the Ballon d’Or’s leading contenders, and the current poll asks fans to judge that particular campaign against the greatest individual seasons produced by other multiple winners.Ronaldo’s Ballon d’Or record, from first nomination to five winsRonaldo first received a Ballon d’Or nomination in 2004, after joining Manchester United from Sporting CP. He went on to earn 18 nominations, one more than Messi’s 17, and remained a regular presence on the shortlist for roughly 15 years.His first victory came in 2008, followed by a second in 2013 and another in 2014. The 2013 award was disputed by some observers who believed Franck Ribéry deserved recognition after Bayern Munich’s treble-winning season, while Ronaldo’s 2014 victory followed another prolific year.In 2016, Ronaldo won after helping Portugal claim the European Championship and Real Madrid lift the Champions League, taking the award by a record margin. He secured his fifth and most recent Ballon d’Or in 2017, after Madrid won another European title.Messi, meanwhile, has won the award eight times: in 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2015, 2019, 2021 and 2023. The fan vote does not alter that overall tally, but it offers a separate comparison between individual campaigns.Why the vote matters to Ronaldo nowRonaldo received no votes in the 2022 Ballon d’Or and has not returned to the 30-player shortlist since, following his move away from European football and his second departure from Manchester United in 2022. Now playing in Saudi Arabia for Al-Nassr, he is nearing the later stages of a career that brought him major honours with Manchester United, Real Madrid and Juventus.His lead in the B.O.A.T. poll is a reminder of the season that began his Ballon d’Or legacy, rather than evidence that he is returning to contention for the current award. The 2026 ceremony is scheduled for October 26 at London’s Palladium, marking the 70th edition and the first time the gala has been held in the United Kingdom, in honour of inaugural winner Sir Stanley Matthews.The fan vote will close the following night, with its result due on October 28. articles.standfirst: El '47' del Manchester City puso fin a la sequía más larga de su carrera: ¡307 días! sin marcar
articles.summary: El '47' del Manchester City puso fin a la sequía más larga de su carrera: ¡307 días! sin marcar
articles.body: "Mañana marca", vaticinó Enzo Maresca al referirse a Phil Foden (Stockport, 2000), que regresaba a la convocatoria después de cumplir tres partidos de sanción por la patada desde el suelo que propinó a Bruno Fernandes en el derbi de Mánchester: Un pronóstico sin demasiado riesgo aparente de no ser porque el mediapunta del City llevaba sin marcar... ¡¡¡desde el 14 de diciembre de 2025!!! contra el Crystal Palace (0-3). No es de extrañar que el 'MVP' de la Premier 2023-24 cerrara la temporada pasada con un rol secundario en los planes de Guardiola: en la eliminatoria contra el Real Madrid, por ejemplo, no disputó ni un minuto. "¿Por qué pasa de jugar todos los partidos a apenas tener minutos? Hay algo ahí y no siempre lo sabemos todo. Podría tener un golpe o una lesión que tienen que proteger y no puede llegar a su nivel en los entrenamientos", sugería Michael Brown, ex del City. Sin embargo, Foden, que se quedó fuera de la lista de Inglaterra para el Mundial por su bajo rendimiento, no quiso dejar mal a Maresca. Apenas 19 minutos necesitó el dorsal '47' del City para poner fin a la mayor sequía de su carrera: 307 días sin marcar. Recibió de Doku y marcó a placer con la zurda en boca de gol para 'abrir la lata' en la victoria contra el Ipswich (3-2) y, de paso, ayudar a Maresca a firmar el mejor inicio de un entrenador recién llegado en la historia de la Premier. "¡Llevaba mucho tiempo necesitando este gol! Sólo me puede hacer bien para mi confianza. Mi objetivo principal es ayudar al equipo lo mejor que pueda e intentar hacer mi trabajo", reconocía Foden, que suma 111 tantos y 70 asistencias en 376 partidos con los 'sky blues'. Hay un dato curioso, eso sí: ninguno de sus 111 tantos ha llegado de penalti. "No hay mejor sensación", aseguró Foden, designado 'MVP', vía 'X'. "Siempre me pongo estándares muy altos para intentar marcar y asistir. Como llevaba mucho tiempo sin marcar, sólo he estado tratando de practicar al máximo en los entrenamientos y espero que haya valido la pena. Finalmente lo he logrado y ¡estoy realmente feliz! El primero siempre es el más difícil de marcar", aseguraba en la 'BBC'. Atrás queda ya su sanción contra el United: "Ha sido una época muy dura. Llevo más de un mes sin poder jugar, así que ha sido bastante molesto. He tenido que ser paciente, entrenar por mi cuenta a veces, no ha sido fácil. Pero salir al campo, marcar y conseguir los tres puntos... es en lo que llevaba pensando desde hace mucho tiempo". Ahora, en su horizonte, se abre un nuevo escenario. Y es que, a falta de un recambio natural para Haaland, Maresca no descarta tirar de Foden como 'falso 9': "El '9' es Erling, pero él ya ha jugado en esa posición en el pasado, así que puede volver a hacerlo ahora de nuevo". La buena nueva es que Foden, por fin, ha regresado del lado oscuro.

articles.body: Antxon Muneta deja de ser el entrenador del CD Mirandés. El club rojillo ha anunciado la decisión de poner fin a su vinculación contractual tras la reunión de su Consejo de Administración. La salida del técnico llega acompañada de las de Alain Arroyo y César Remón, que tampoco continuarán en el cuerpo técnico del primer equipo. La entidad ha dedicado buena parte de su comunicado a agradecer el trabajo, el esfuerzo y el compromiso de Muneta durante su etapa en el banquillo. El Mirandés ha reconocido especialmente la valentía con la que afrontó la pasada temporada, cuando el equipo mantuvo hasta el último momento la esperanza de lograr la permanencia en Segunda División. También ha destacado su implicación personal y profesional al aceptar el reto de encabezar el proyecto de esta campaña en Primera Federación. El club ha subrayado que Muneta asumió una etapa exigente con responsabilidad y defendió los intereses de la entidad ante cada desafío. En su despedida, ha agradecido su dedicación y su disposición para continuar al frente de un proyecto que siente como propio, además de desearle suerte en sus próximos retos profesionales y personales. “Antxon siempre tendrá nuestro cariño y reconocimiento por el camino compartido y por su compromiso con el escudo rojillo”, recoge el comunicado. Arroyo y Remón también dejan el club La decisión alcanza también a Alain Arroyo y César Remón, que dejan de desempeñar sus funciones en el cuerpo técnico. El Mirandés ha reconocido el trabajo, la dedicación y la profesionalidad de ambos durante su paso por la entidad y les ha trasladado sus mejores deseos para el futuro. El comunicado reúne a los tres integrantes del cuerpo técnico en su despedida: “Gracias, Antxon, Alain y César, por vuestro trabajo y por haber formado parte de la familia rojilla".

articles.body:
It's Monday, and we are back at it! Football season is firing on all cylinders, and we have you covered. As always, check out our original coverage and what we can find on the World Wide Web below.

Air Force has not missed a beat since starting quarterback Liam Szarka went out for the season. In fact, the triple option appears to be in full force despite almost completely abandoning the passing game. They actually completed two passes this week, but the 430 rushing yards allowed them to run right over UNLV's defense. Medders accounted for 3 rushing TDs and Rocco Conti and Owen Allen were around 100 yards on the ground with TDs as well. The Falcons look as good as anyone right now.

Oregon State continues to embarrass teams, with Washington State being the latest to be no match for OSU. The star players were doing star things: quarterback Brady Atkinson threw for over 300 yards and 3 TDs, and Jesse Legree found the end zone twice while catching over 100 yards. AJ Newberry joined him in the scoring and went over 100 yards on 5 catches. The Cougars found some offense, putting up 30 points, but half of that was in the third quarter.

This isn't a surprise, but North Dakota State is bowl-eligible for their first year in the Mountain West at the FBS level. How they got there was a bit of a surprise, leading Nevada by a mere touchdown entering the fourth quarter. The Bison were aided by a touchdown return off of a missed field goal by the Wolf Pack just before halftime. Nathan Hayes bounced back from last week with 2 touchdowns to lead a balanced offensive attack, while the defense forced 2 interceptions and held Nevada to under 100 yards rushing.

In a Pac-12 rivalry game, San Diego State bounced back from their last embarrassing defeat to capture the Old Oil Can in the game against Fresno State. They were in control from the start, going up 10-0 and up 16-10 at halftime. The Bulldogs kept battling back, but SDSU used a steady ground game, paced by the return of Lucky Sutton and his 110 rushing yards. The game also saw Jayden Denegal go down with an injury, so two other QBs came in, including Bert Emanuel Jr., who only threw one pass, but it ended up being a touchdown. The Aztecs sealed the victory with a game-winning field goal from Cooper DiLeva, his fourth of the game.

While not official yet, many key details have been reported about what CFP expansion will look like. The Athletic says that it will feature the long-assumed 24 teams. The CFP will bring in over an additional $300 million per year, with ESPN retaining its exclusive rights. The five auto bids will remain, going to four power conference champs, plus the highest G6 team, with the rest being at-large spots. The top 8 get a bye, while teams 9-16 host teams 17-24. Conference championships are expected to be eliminated, although the schedule is still being finalized. In addition to scheduling, the biggest question remaining is do P4 teams need to play 10 or more P4 teams to qualify for an at-large berth? And if so, does that mean a G6 team could never get an at-large bid? Love it or hate it, the expanded playoff is coming because teams are spending so much money on rosters and need some proof that there is a return on investment by making the 24 team field.

articles.title: Journalist brands Arsenal as “Mikel Arteta’s unwatchables”
articles.summary: Arsenal were once regarded as revolutionaries in English football following Arsène Wenger’s arrival as manager. The Frenchman transformed the Gunners’ style...
articles.body:
Arsenal were once regarded as revolutionaries in English football following Arsène Wenger's arrival as manager. The Frenchman transformed the Gunners' style of play, attracted new generations of supporters and helped make the Premier League more appealing to football fans around the world.

Wenger built a reputation for attractive football, with his teams becoming known for their technical quality and attacking approach. However, by the time he left the club, Arsenal had fallen behind Manchester City, who had appointed Pep Guardiola and established themselves among the leading forces in English football.

Guardiola brought the philosophy that had distinguished his teams at Barcelona and Bayern Munich to English football. Under his leadership, City developed a recognisable style built around possession, movement and attacking control, setting a high standard for their domestic rivals.

Arsenal now have Mikel Arteta in charge, and supporters might have expected a similar approach because he spent three seasons working under Guardiola before taking the managerial role at the Emirates. However, the football produced by the Gunners has drawn criticism from those who believe it lacks the excitement associated with Wenger's greatest teams.

Although Arsenal have remained competitive, questions continue to surround their attacking play. Their recent match against Nottingham Forest provided another talking point, with the Gunners securing a 1-0 victory despite managing only one shot on target.

The narrow win ensured Arsenal collected three important points, but the performance did little to silence critics who want to see more creativity and attacking intent. For a team with significant investment in its starting line-up, expectations remain high, and supporters naturally want performances that match the club's ambitions.

Journalist Tom Collomosse assessed Arsenal's display against Forest and compared the current team unfavourably with the club's celebrated past. Writing in the Daily Mail , he delivered a sharp verdict on Arteta's side and their approach in the final third.

"Sadly, where once we had Arsene Wenger's Invincibles, we now endure Mikel Arteta's Unwatchables. One shot on target, one goal, three points. For the second time this season, there were no through-balls. That's what you get for your £600million starting XI, folks."

The criticism reflects concerns about Arsenal's creativity and their ability to entertain while pursuing results. Arteta will be pleased with the points, but the challenge remains to deliver more convincing attacking performances as the season progresses.

articles.title: Atlético Madrid name squad to face Stuttgart in UEFA Champions League
articles.summary: Koke and Cristian Romero have been left out of the Atlético de Madrid squad to face VfB Stuttgart in the UEFA Champions League on Tuesday night. Ahead of Atl...
articles.body:
Koke and Cristian Romero have been left out of the Atlético de Madrid squad to face VfB Stuttgart in the UEFA Champions League on Tuesday night.

Ahead of Atlético's first-ever meeting with Stuttgart, Diego Simeone's defense was dealt a significant blow after the coach revealed that Romero asked to be subbed off during Atleti's 1-0 win at Espanyol on Saturday. The star defender underwent tests which revealed a small adductor strain , an injury that will rule him out of the trip to Germany as well as next weekend's home match against Deportivo A Coruña.

Koke had a tough week as his mother died last Tuesday and he is still recovering from a left hamstring strain that caused him to miss the Espanyol game. The captain's timetable to return remains uncertain.

In better news, Johnny Cardoso trained in the gym on Sunday, and he has been included in the squad after he missed the Espanyol match due to gastroenteritis.

Atlético enter the Stuttgart game on a six-game winning streak, though the Colchoneros historically have a horrible record when facing German clubs in Germany. Under Simeone, Atlético have lost eight of 10 games in Germany; the most recent win was against Bayer Leverkusen in 2017 .

(Similarly, Stuttgart have never beaten a Spanish team in European competition, with a record of three draws and five losses to date.)

Stuttgart have struggled domestically with only six points from the opening six rounds of the Bundesliga, but Die Roten have taken six of six points in the Champions League. Sebastian Hoeneß' men defeated Viking FK at home and Slovan Bratislava away to kick off the league phase.

articles.title: Erling Haaland doubt, Antoine Semenyo injured: Who could play for Man City against AEK Athens?
articles.summary: Manchester City coach Enzo Maresca explores his attacking options for Tuesday's Champions League game against AEK Athens.
articles.body:
Manchester City face the prospect of being without star striker Erling Haaland for Tuesday's Champions League game against AEK Athens.

The Norway international scored twice in Saturday's 3-2 victory over Ipswich Town to take his tally to eight Premier League goals for the season, leading the top-flight scoring charts once more.

But the 26-year-old suffered a blow to the foot in the game and is now a doubt for the European night at Etihad Stadium, as City look to get back to winning ways in the competition after last week's 4-2 defeat by Paris St-Germain.

"To replace Erling is always difficult but we have some different options," said manager Enzo Maresca. "It also depends on the gameplan.

"At the moment it is Erling. Why do we need to think of a different nine if Erling is there? If something happened or we need a different nine plan, we'll see."

Should Haaland not make a recovery, it would leave Maresca with a dilemma on who to select up front after Antoine Semenyo was ruled out for eight weeks with the left knee injury he picked up in the win over Ipswich .

Boos and bananas on day of defiance at Man City

Haaland has scored in six consecutive top-flight games to help City to the top of the table with a flawless start from their opening seven games of the campaign.

Against Ipswich , he scored his 100th non-penalty goal in the Premier League, reaching this milestone in fewer appearances than any other player.

Maresca said Haaland "can be available" against AEK and will be assessed after training on Monday, but the player was not present during the session which was open to the media.

Players can find it difficult to feature as back-ups to Haaland, as Julian Alvarez and Omar Marmoush have found in the past, but it was a surprise when Divin Mubama was allowed to join Championship side Southampton on loan in the summer.

It left City without a natural replacement in Haaland's absence.

Maresca has previously said Semenyo can be used "as a nine" but that plan is no longer available with the Ghanaian facing the prospect of missing up to 13 matches.

One option mooted by the Italian is midfielder Phil Foden, who ended his barren run in front of goal on Saturday by scoring his first Premier League goal since December.

"Phil can be one of the solutions," said Maresca. "He played already in the past in that position so could play again, but at the moment the number nine is Erling."

Could summer signing Iliman Ndiaye be another option?

The Senegal international was often deployed as a striker in Sheffield United's promotion-winning campaign in 2022-23, scoring 14 goals to help the Blades return to the Premier League.

Last season, manager Pep Guardiola said Rayan Cherki fits playing in the false nine role "perfectly", with the Frenchman scoring in a 2-0 Carabao Cup quarter-final win over Brentford when used in that position.

The City forward appeared as a 77th-minute substitute on Saturday but hobbled straight down the tunnel at full-time with Maresca initially expecting an "even worse injury".

The Ghana international has made 10 appearances in all competitions this season, scoring two goals and providing three assists.

"To lose Antoine or any player is not good," Maresca said on Monday.

"In the first moment we expected an even worse injury, so we were more worried, but after Sunday's scan we feel much better.

"It could be eight weeks. The most important thing for him is to recover and also when he is back, probably around December, we will have a new player in terms of energy.

"It is a collateral [knee injury], something like this. It is not a muscle problem."

Jeremy Doku started on the left flank against Ipswich and should continue in that role in the absence of Semenyo.

articles.title: B/R's 2026 College Football Playoff Bracket Projections and Predictions after Week 7
articles.summary: Nobody knows anything. And it's just so beautiful.
articles.body:
Nobody knows anything. And it's just so beautiful.

Week 7 provided one of the wildest slates that college football has ever seen. For the first time in history, five teams holding a top-seven ranking in the AP Top 25 lost on the same weekend.

Georgia dropped a shocker to Auburn. Notre Dame fell at BYU. Indiana narrowly lost to Ohio State, Alabama had a miserable day at Tennessee and Texas imploded at home against Florida.

And, boy, if Miami didn't give it a serious try at joining the list, too.

The result of that wonderfully chaotic Saturday of action is a major overhaul of the College Football Playoff picture.

The projected bracket is a reflection of B/R's Top 25 dropped into the organization of the official CFP format.

Auburn 27, Georgia 24 Tennessee 26, Alabama 10 Florida 27, Texas 24

In the best possible way, the SEC is now an absolute disaster. Georgia stood as the last unbeaten team in the conference, also holding the No. 1 national ranking. But after Florida stormed back to beat Texas and while Tennessee shut down Alabama, Auburn clipped UGA to break the league race wiiide open.

The streak is over. Long live the streak. Indiana had ripped off 22 straight wins, and the Hoosiers were literal inches from likely extending the streak. Nick Marsh, though, ever-so-narrowly lost track of his place on the field and just missed a toe-tapping touchdown. Ohio State must survive the next few weeks (at least) without quarterback Julian Sayin , but the Buckeyes landed a crucial Big Ten victory.

Yes, the game ended in slight controversy—a pass interference could've been flagged, and there was certainly one second left on the clock. Still, it's not like BYU didn't deserve the victory. The program is now ranked No. 2 in the country, its highest spot since the 1984 team's perfect year.

1. Miami 2. BYU 3. Ohio State 4. Georgia 5. Indiana 6. Utah 7. Notre Dame 8. Texas Tech 9. Ole Miss 10. UCLA 11. Tennessee 12. USC 13. Alabama 14. Kentucky 15. Iowa 16. Houston 17. LSU 18. Wake Forest 19. Florida 20. Arizona 21. Boise State 22. SMU 23. James Madison 24. Northwestern 25. Auburn

Seeding is a reflection of how B/R's Top 25 would shape the bracket.

Power 4 Champions and Top Group of 6 Team

Thanks to a 17-7 win over Wisconsin on Saturday, UCLA improved to 6-0. First-year coach Bob Chesney has engineered a remarkable turnaround for the Bruins, who hadn't attained bowl eligibility in the last two seasons.

Tennessee has been competitive lately, but expectations were a bit lower entering the 2026 campaign due to inexperience at QB. The position is still unsettled, yet the Vols leaned on their rushing attack—DeSean Bishop had 159 yards with two scores—and a stout defense to take down rival Alabama and jump to 6-1.

Look, the potential QB issues at both programs are tough to overlook. I, personally, am not sold on UCLA or UT as legit contenders in December.

But right now, we cannot possibly ignore the Bruins and Vols.

Auburn stuck with Florida and hung around at Tennessee, so a competitive clash with Georgia was no surprise. Winning, though? On the road? That was a statement LSU, obviously, will not ignore. The loser of this matchup will have three SEC losses and essentially be eliminated from the conference race.

As of this writing, we haven't heard if Texas will make a QB change. Arch Manning's time as the starter is running thin —and that's saying it kindly. No matter who's under center, a third loss for the Horns would be devastating to their fleeting CFP dreams.

The most impactful game of Week 8 is also the last kickoff for Saturday's slate. Houston sports a 6-1 record, and this'll probably be the final ranked opponent on the Cougars' schedule this season. Utah, however, is unbeaten at 6-0 and could add a first Top 25 victory to its résumé.

articles.standfirst: Tiene 18 años y llegó hace cinco a La Masia: es indiscutible para Belletti
articles.summary: Tiene 18 años y llegó hace cinco a La Masia: es indiscutible para Belletti
articles.body: Hansi Flick sigue recurriendo, de forma decidida, al fútbol base. El técnico culé completó hoy lunes la lista de convocados para el cruce de mañana contra el PSG, ante las bajas por lesión de Jules Koundé y Eric García (que se suman a la de Andreas Christensen), con el joven Àlex Campos. También está en la expedición Hamza Abdelkarim, ya habitual con el primer equipo. Àlex Campos es uno de los centrales indiscutibles y fijos en el once de Juliano Belletti. El futbolista de Aitona (Lleida) llegó a la cantera azulgrana en el verano de 2021, procedente del Atlètic Segre, y se incorporó en el segundo año de la etapa cadete. El internacional sub 19, de 18 años, debutó oficialmente en la temporada 2025-26 (el 28 de septiembre de 2025), todavía siendo juvenil de segundo año, con el Barça Atlètic: fue en el campo de la UE Sant Andreu, en la cuarta jornada de Liga. El central diestro, que también puede jugar de pivote, ha progresado en el fútbol base con paso firme hasta convertirse en uno de los zagueros más destacados de la cantera culé y con mayor proyección, aunque no fue citado para hacer la pretemporada con Flick. Esta campaña, ha participado en los siete encuentros del filial en Segunda Federación, en todos ha salido de inicio y ha completado los 90 minutos. Y también ha festejado un gol: el que firmó contra el CD Tudelano. Campos, que el pasado mes de julio renovó con el Barcelona hasta junio de 2029 con opción a una campaña más, destaca por su dominio del juego aéreo en las dos áreas (mide 1,85 metros), por ser expeditivo y contundente en el corte, por su buena salida de balón... Flick confía en él para uno de los encuentros más competidos de la temporada.

articles.title: PSG vs Barcelona match will not be postponed despite protests: French PM
articles.summary: Barcelona have arrived in Paris for the Champions League match at the Parc des Princes on Tuesday at 19:00 GMT.
articles.body:
The upcoming UEFA Champions League match between Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) and Barcelona will not be postponed or cancelled despite the ongoing violent protests in France, the country’s Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu has said.

Lecornu said on Monday he had asked regional authorities to impose “partial” and “localised” curfews in some cities to protect businesses after weekend demonstrations spilled over into some of the worst street violence in recent years.

He said a state of emergency could be imposed “if necessary”, adding that curfews were a better solution to the crisis over violent protests.

“I am absolutely determined to restore order,” Lecornu said at a news conference after a crisis meeting.

“A state of emergency is still a very serious measure, including in terms of its implementation. So if it is necessary, of course we could do it. As things stand, however, the issue of curfews, and the implementation of those curfews, seems better suited to the situation we may be facing.”

He did not say which cities ‌‌would impose partial curfews nor what form they would take, although he ruled out imposing a full curfew across Paris.

“These curfews must be local and partial. It is out of the question to put all of Paris ⁠⁠under curfew.”

At the same news conference, Interior Minister Laurent Nunez told reporters there were no plans to cancel the ⁠⁠match.

PSG, the reigning European and French champions, will host the Spanish visitors at the Parc des Princes on Tuesday night.

The fate of the match, touted as the pick of the group-stage fixtures in European football’s premier club competition, has been under threat after days of protests across the French capital and beyond.

However, neither club has indicated that the violence will affect the fixture, as Barcelona were arrived across their northern border to Paris on Monday afternoon.

The match is scheduled to kick off at 19:00 GMT on Tuesday.

The weekend of riots and looting has not spared French clubs, such as Marseille and Lille. The Ligue 1 clubs said their shops were vandalised during the protests.

Marseille said in a statement on Monday the looters caused “significant damage” to its official store located on La Canebiere — the southern port city’s most famous avenue — which has been temporarily closed.

Up north, Lille’s city centre store “suffered extensive damage and widespread looting”, the club said, adding that the shop will remain closed until further notice.

Lille thanked “everyone who has offered their support over the past few hours — first and foremost, our store employees, but also the many passersby, whether supporters or not, who spontaneously stepped forward to offer their help, practical assistance and comfort”.

articles.summary: PARIS (AP) — The weekend of riots and looting in France did not spare soccer clubs Marseille and Lille.
articles.body:
PARIS (AP) — The weekend of riots and looting in France did not spare soccer clubs Marseille and Lille.

The Ligue 1 teams said their shops have been vandalized during the protests against rising living costs and poor conditions in schools . Over half a million mainly peaceful protesters took to the streets on Saturday but small groups of people set fires in the streets and looted businesses in Paris, Lyon, Marseille and other cities.

Marseille said in a statement on Monday the looters caused "significant damage" to its official store located on La Canebière — the southern port city's most famous avenue — which has been temporarily closed.

Kobe's daughter features in in Victoria's Secret Fashion Show

The Marseille prosecutor's office said 101 people, including 27 underage individuals, were arrested following the looting.

Up north, Lille's city center store "suffered extensive damage and widespread looting," the club said, adding that the shop will remain closed until further notice.

Lille thanked "everyone who has offered their support over the past few hours — first and foremost, our store employees, but also the many passersby, whether supporters or not, who spontaneously stepped forward to offer their help, practical assistance and comfort."

articles.title: Sarkisian Addresses Arch Manning-KJ Lacey Jr.'s QB1 Battle amid Rumors After Texas' Loss to Florida
articles.summary: Texas is sticking with Arch Manning as the starting quarterback but could be laying the groundwork for an eventual change under center.
articles.body:
Texas is sticking with Arch Manning as the starting quarterback but could be laying the groundwork for an eventual change under center.

Head coach Steve Sarkisian made it clear that Manning will remain the team's starter on Monday:

Arch Manning's tenure with Texas may be nearing end

That comes after ESPN's Pete Thamel reported Monday that Karle "KJ" Lacey Jr. is expected to receive "an uptick in first-team quarterback reps."

Lacey, a 4-star recruit in the 2025 class, thrown nine passes for 70 yards through his two seasons on the Longhorns.

Sarkisian told reporters he planned to "evaluate everything" after a 27-24 loss to Florida, which saw the team throw away a 14-point first-half lead. He added that Manning wouldn't be exempt from the personnel evaluations.

The junior committed a costly fumble as Texas was attempting to at least tie the game late in the fourth quarter. Florida recovered the ball and ate up the final 1:58 to secure the win.

That benching Manning could even be on the table reflects how he has performed throughout the season. He has thrown for 1,295 yards, 11 touchdowns and five interceptions. His yards per game have fallen from 243.3 in 2025 to 215.8.

Four years into his stint in Austin, Manning hasn't shown a lot in the way of improvement. The moments when he looks like an NFL-caliber thrower are far overshadowed by his inconsistency and bad decision-making.

Sarkisian asserted last week that Manning may not receive as much scrutiny if he were "Joe Smith" and not somebody with such a decorated lineage. The flip side is that Manning might've been benched already if he were any other former 5-star recruit yet to pan out by Year 4.

For now, getting Lacey more looks with the first team is likely about sending a message more than anything else. Having said that, a coach doesn't take this step without having the wherewithal to follow through if a QB change is merited.

The Longhorns host No. 7 Ole Miss on Saturday. Should Manning once again struggle, elevating Lacey to QB1 status might be a serious possibility.

articles.title: Álex Primo vuelve a sonreír
articles.standfirst: El portero del Levante regresa a los entrenamientos tras ser intervenido quirúrgicamente del hombro el pasado mes de mayo
articles.summary: El portero del Levante regresa a los entrenamientos tras ser intervenido quirúrgicamente del hombro el pasado mes de mayo
articles.body: Álex Primo vuelve a los terrenos de juego y eso es sinónimo de sonrisa. El actual tercer portero del Levante ha regresado a los entrenamientos junto al resto después de cuatro meses apartado por una lesión en el hombro que sufrió el pasado mes de abril. El guardameta, formado en la cantera del conjunto valenciano, sufrió una lesión de labrum el pasado 26 de abril y, después de intentar esquivar pasar por quirófano, tuvo que ser intervenido el 14 de mayo. Tras su regreso al trabajo colectivo, el portero ha explicado sus primeras sensaciones. “Al principio ha sido un poco raro, pero poco a poco me he ido adaptando. Sensaciones muy buenas, muy positivas y tenía muchas ganas de que llegara el día”, reconoce. Durante estos meses, una de las cosas que más ha echado de menos ha sido compartir el día a día con el equipo, pero también vivir la competición desde dentro. “Soy una persona que vive mucho los partidos y deseo que llegue el fin de semana para poder ayudar en lo que se me necesite. Eso sí que se echa en falta”, explica. Así mismo, tras superar los momentos más complicados, Primo regresa con una perspectiva diferente y con más ganas que nunca de disfrutar de su profesión. “Cuando uno está bien, cuando está entrenando en el día a día, no valoramos lo que es poder estar bien físicamente y poder estar con el grupo. Estoy muy contento de poder estar de vuelta y ayudar en lo que se me necesite”, apunta el guardameta.

articles.title: Why Michael Carrick's Man Utd side continue to divide opinion following another disjointed display at Elland Road
articles.summary: Man Utd are winless in their last six games across all competitions; they stand 13th in the Premier League table, their worst start to a top-flight campaign for 40 years; Michael Carrick believes his side can still 'have a good season' - but how is success even measured these days?
articles.body:
That is Manchester United in this moment. A confusing mix of juxtapositions. A club obsessed with taking one step forward and two steps back. Only ever one result away from complete disaster.

Carrick's position remains precariously poised given United have only won two of 10 games in all competitions so far this season. To speak of fresh starts as early as October surely evokes more worry than it arrests. The sentiment is understandable. But why is it necessary?

The sense of calm that Carrick has overseen at Old Trafford since succeeding Ruben Amorim's melodrama in January is close to shattering, despite what he perceived to be improvement at Elland Road. And that is the point, isn't it? That a 1-1 draw at Leeds is actually presented as success.

That another lead blown is an acceptable balance of probability in Carrick's favour because United did not completely buckle after Dominic Calvert-Lewin's equaliser. In truth, United only competed in fits and starts. Another performance made up of individual parts.

The momentum chart below shows two periods of the game where the visitors exerted control, once in the first half, when Bryan Mbeumo scored, and for 15 minutes in the second half. Daniel Farke believed his side were the only team to show any inclination towards winning the game.

Of course the source must be considered, but most would politely agree with the German's reading. The stats corroborate Farke's version of events. Leeds had 61 per cent of the ball, a greater xG value, more touches in the opposition box, ran further, sprinted faster and finished with 73 final-third entries to United's 59.

Carrick's side, playing without a recognised striker to match Leeds' structure, struggled for sustained rhythm despite taking the lead, with Diogo Dalot as their main source of chance creation. Not Bruno Fernandes. Not Bryan Mbeumo or Amad. Dalot. How can that be possible?

The fact Carrick felt the need to change his formation to mirror Leeds is really the ultimate clincher. An admittance that United in their preferred arrangement would have been too easy to play through, having not managed to keep a clean sheet in the league all season. This is a low ebb.

And so we reach another week on trial. Under examination will be a trip to Como in the Champions League before a home meeting with Bournemouth, live on Sky Sports on Sunday. Neither appear particularly favourable.

But what fixture does, when you have amassed your fewest victories at this stage of a top-flight campaign for 40 years? Carrick can only work with what he has available. And what he has available is an unbalanced squad low on confidence and shirking responsibility for poor results.

There is no escaping the form of those who were previously Carrick's most relied upon. Fernandes as captain has been largely anonymous. Harry Maguire has lacked leadership. And the outspoken Lisandro Martinez has done little but prove himself to be an outlaw of epic proportions.

"I am encouraged by a lot of things. I think we can still have a really good season," concluded Carrick on Sunday. But what has come to define a 'good season' at Manchester United has changed beyond recognition. What does that statement even mean?

A rolling one-point-per-game average is relegation form.

As a result, Carrick's credit is surely beginning to run low. He faces another defining week in the dugout. He has to get it right. Or United's season risks being over before its properly begun.

articles.title: Man City’s Semenyo out for up to eight weeks due to knee injury
articles.summary: City coach confirmed Semenyo’s injury but said Haaland would be available for the Champions League match on Tuesday.
articles.body:
Manchester City ‌‌forward Antoine Semenyo has been sidelined for up to eight weeks after suffering ⁠⁠a knee injury at ⁠⁠the weekend, but striker Erling Haaland could be fit for the club’s Champions League clash at home to AEK Athens, manager Enzo Maresca said.

Maresca said on Monday that Semenyo’s injury was ⁠⁠not as bad as first feared, but the 26-year-old, who has two goals and three assists in the Premier League this season, needed time to recover.

Ghana international Semenyo ⁠⁠limped to the tunnel following Saturday’s 3-2 home win over Ipswich Town, shortly after Haaland took a knock on his foot and ankle in stoppage time.

“It could be eight weeks. Now the most important thing is recovery. When he is back in December, it will be like a new ‌‌player. Collateral. It’s not muscle,” he told a news conference ahead of Tuesday’s AEK game.

Semenyo was among the substitutes against Ipswich but came off the bench in the 77th minute at the Etihad Stadium.

“We tried to save him, we tried to keep him fresh, just give him some minutes, he didn’t play a lot, but sometimes things happen we cannot control,” added Maresca.

The manager said there were also some doubts ⁠⁠about Norwegian Haaland’s fitness for Tuesday, but he remained hopeful.

“He can ⁠⁠be available, we will see, we have a session now. We have some doubts after Saturday’s game. He was quite good yesterday, better. So we will see today,” Maresca added.

Haaland’s double against Ipswich helped City remain perfect in ⁠⁠the top flight with seven straight wins. The 26-year-old has netted in his last eight appearances for City, scoring 12 times.

“For sure, ⁠⁠to replace Erling it is always difficult but we have ⁠⁠some different options,” Maresca said.

“Phil [Foden] can be one of the solutions, not the only one … but now, at the moment the number nine is Erling.”

Maresca is eyeing the AEK match as a chance for City to bounce back ‌‌from last week’s 4-2 loss at home to European champions Paris St Germain, which left City 17th in the table with three points from two matches.

“I think the response after the ‌‌PSG ‌‌game was quite good … It’s a Champions League game, different competition, but the ambition has to be the same, try to win games,” he added.

articles.title: Gianni Infantino: Uefa gives Fifa deadline to release key documents
articles.summary: Uefa's letter contained 42 questions, covering Fifa's failed private investment proposals, its Peace Prize and the fallout from Folarin Balogun's World Cup red card.
articles.body:
European governing body Uefa has told Fifa it must release key documents and answer all questions relating to its governance and decision-making by a deadline of 2 November.

At the Fifa Council on Thursday, president Gianni Infantino apologised for his World Cup sell-off plan - but failed to offer a full explanation for how the proposal was devised.

In the letter seen by BBC Sport, Uefa general secretary Theodore Theodoridis said that world football's governing body had failed to address "a number of fundamental questions".

"Others remain unanswered, and the information and documentation requested have not been provided," it read.

The letter included eight pages containing 42 questions covering a number of issues, from the Fifa Forward Enterprise (FFE) private investment, to the Fifa Peace Prize and the controversial suspended ban given to USA striker Folarin Balogun at the World Cup.

"The withdrawal of FFE, the acknowledgement of mistakes and the announcement of 'potential governance reforms' do not answer how the relevant decisions were taken or why the Fifa Council was not involved at the appropriate stage," it continued.

"Any refusal to disclose information or documents should be justified individually, with a clear explanation of the specific grounds relied upon.

"These questions require answers now. They cannot be deferred until the next meeting of the Fifa Council - nor can future governance reforms substitute for scrutiny of decisions already taken and accountability for them."

Uefa did not outline what steps it intended to take should Fifa not meet the deadline, but will hope it adds to the pressure on Infantino ahead of November 18, the cut-off date for any candidates to confirm they are standing against him in next year's presidential election.

The questions were first put to Infantino at the Fifa Council last week, with Infantino then asking that they were submitted in writing.

Football Association chair Debbie Hewitt - a Fifa vice-president - said afterwards that "if he doesn't answer those questions, he's not fit to be Fifa president".

Fifa faces question on FFE and funding to associations

Uefa has posed a great number of questions about FFE.

"When was the idea of FFE first explored, by whom and with what objective?" Uefa asked. "Who within Fifa authorised the development of the project, and which members of the Fifa administration were involved?

"What concrete measures will Fifa put in place to ensure that the shortcomings identified in the FFE process cannot occur again in the future?"

Uefa goes on to ask about the circumstances surrounding Infantino's initial presentation of the FFE plan to senior Fifa executives.

In particular, it raises a question about a potential investigation into Fifa in the United States. BBC Sport has approached Uefa to ascertain what this is in relation to.

"According to information received from several sources, two days before the vote by the bureau of the management board on the FFE proposal, the Fifa president informed members of the management board that the US authorities were investigating Fifa's administration," Uefa claim.

"Can he confirm whether such a statement was made and, if so, explain the information on which it was based, the reasons for raising it at that particular moment and whether he considered the potential pressure it might place on members immediately before their decision on FFE?"

Uefa requested information on whether Infantino would have held or expected to hold any position, role or function in FFE, either during or following his tenure as Fifa president.

The relationship with Joshua Kushner's Thrive Capital was covered in detail, asking why an agreement granting exclusivity to the company was signed without prior consultation of the Fifa Council.

"Why was Thrive Capital selected as lead investor, without any competitive tendering process and under conditions of strict confidentiality, despite its links to the family of the recipient of the Fifa Peace Prize?" Uefa asked.

Kushner is the brother of Donald Trump's son-in-law, while the US president was awarded the Peace Prize.

Uefa also requested answer about the award of the Peace Prize, specifically who decided to establish it, for what purpose, and who decided that Trump should receive it.

When the FFE plan was revealed in the days following the World Cup final, Infantino told the 211 member associations (MAs) they would receive $40m (£30m) if they backed it. He then set a deadline of 19 September for federations to accept his plans if they wanted to access an initial $20m (£15m).

However, once the scheme was abandoned, Uefa and Concacaf called on Fifa to pay at least $10m (£7.5m) from its cash reserves to each of the MAs and, last week, Infantino agreed, proposing to increase the amount of money handed out for football development across the world by $3.4bn (£2.6bn).

The releasing of cash from its reserves will result in double the level of planned distribution funding for MAs from 2027 to 2030, with $25m (£19m) available per member association.

"Why was substantially increased funding for MAs presented in connection with FFE and external investment, rather than being financed directly from Fifa's own resources?" Uefa has asked.

"Given Fifa's strong financial position, why was it considered necessary to seek investment from private investors? What financial or strategic advantages would such an arrangement have offered compared with funding football development directly from Fifa's own resources, particularly in light of Fifa's subsequent proposal to do precisely that on a substantially increased scale?"

While Fifa is yet to respond, sources have indicated its ability to answer certain questions are restricted by the legal action that Uefa has launched. Last month, it filed legal papers in the US requesting disclosure of evidence and documents from Fifa, warning it could lodge a criminal complaint in Switzerland.

Uefa wants answers over Balogun suspension

Infantino has faced intense scrutiny over the case of Balogun, who avoided an immediate suspension after being sent off at the World Cup.

Balogun's ban was lifted by Fifa's disciplinary committee, after US President Donald Trump asked Infantino for the decision to be reviewed.

Fifa insisted the committee was independent but its legal committee is now reviewing a proposal to amend its disciplinary code, which would prevent a repeat, with an update due in December. Uefa has asked why this is necessary.

"President Trump publicly acknowledged having called the Fifa president to request a review of the Balogun disciplinary case. What exactly did he ask him to do, and what was his response?", Uefa has asked. "Would the case have been reviewed in the absence of his intervention?"

"Following that conversation, did the Fifa president or the Fifa secretary general communicate with anyone within Fifa, including members of the administration or the chair of the disciplinary committee, concerning the Balogun case? If so, could Fifa specify with whom, when and the nature of those communications?

"We also request all correspondence and other communications concerning the case between the chair of the disciplinary committee and the Fifa administration, including the Fifa president and Fifa's chief legal officer.

"Could Fifa provide the full written reasons for the decision in the Balogun case, including the information and evidence before the disciplinary committee?

"Who decided that the matter should be determined by a single member of the committee, on what basis…and what were the exceptional circumstances relied upon to justify the decision?"

Uefa also asked why no disciplinary action was taken against DR Congo after the African nation reportedly played an ineligible player in World Cup qualifying. Usually, this would result in the country being disqualified but no action was taken.

Infantino quizzed over 'additional salary' claim

Reports in the lead-up last week's Fifa Council suggested Infantino had received an additional salary from Fifa's US World Cup organising entity (FWC2026 US Inc.) which was not disclosed in Fifa's annual report.

Uefa has asked Fifa to "clarify the nature, amount and basis of these payments, why they were not disclosed and whether they were reviewed and approved by the competent Fifa bodies."

It added: "Could Fifa also confirm whether the additional remuneration was treated as taxable income and whether the corresponding income tax was paid?"

Fifa has previously denied paying Infantino a second salary, and insisted it complies with all reporting requirements in relation to compensation, saying it "strongly rejects any claims that it has failed to disclose any financial information and has violated Fifa's statutes."

Uefa also asked about reported "advanced discussions involving the US president and individuals associated with him concerning a Fifa cryptocurrency", and the $75m (£56.3m) investment in Palestine via Trump's Board of Peace.

The extended 27-minute half-time interval during the World Cup final and introduction of mandatory hydration breaks were also raised.

Uefa wanted answers on the "seven-year, $4m (£3m) lease of office premises in Trump Tower, New York, involving Eric Trump, for premises reportedly unused for much of the year".

It wrote: "These matters, taken together, raise questions that extend beyond the ordinary institutional relationship between Fifa and the government of a World Cup host country.

"Could Fifa provide a detailed explanation of these arrangements and interventions, including the decision-making processes followed, the identification and management of any potential conflicts of interest, the financial implications for Fifa and the extent to which the competent Fifa bodies were informed or consulted?"

Also brought up was the impartiality of the chair of the Fifa electoral committee before next year's presidential election who, Uefa says, "attended the entire 2026 World Cup as an accredited individual, with his expenses covered by Fifa for more than five weeks".

It also asked for a full list of the guests seated in the VIP and VVIP sections "including their names, positions and the reasons for their invitations".

articles.title: Los 10 millones que se le han 'atragantado' al Valencia
articles.standfirst: Sato y Arnau Martínez, los únicos jugadores por los que el Valencia pagó en este mercado, desaparecen de la rotación tras arrancar como titulares
articles.summary: Sato y Arnau Martínez, los únicos jugadores por los que el Valencia pagó en este mercado, desaparecen de la rotación tras arrancar como titulares
articles.body: El mercado del Valencia este verano volvió a ser a mínimos. Poca inversión en jugadores y la gran mayoría de los mismos llegando al equipo cedidos o a coste cero. Pero hubo dos excepciones. Dos jugadores por los que se invirtió una cantidad importante si se compara con las temporadas desde las que Lim decidió dejar de poner dinero para fichajes. Sato y Arnau. El mediapunta y el lateral han seguido caminos idénticos y han desaparecido del equipo de forma fulgurante. Ambos iniciaron la temporada siendo titulares y ambos han desaparecido. El japonés fue una apuesta que se ha quedado sin continuidad. Fue titular en los primeros tres encuentros de Liga con Corberán en el banquillo, suplente ante el Barcelona y titular nuevamente en el último partido del de Cheste al frete del equipo. Desde su destitución su rol ha cambiado de forma radical ni Óscar ni Aguirre le han dado minuto alguno y lleva cuatro partidos 'calentando' banquillo y sin saltar a terreno de juego. El Valencia pagó cuatro millones por el nipón que ahora mismo no entra ni en la rotación. El caso de Arnau es más sangrante. El Valencia se pasó todo el verano intentando fichar un lateral derecho. Días después de lograr la llegada de Mafeo, el club pagó más de cinco millones y medio por Arnau y logró que el Girona aceptase el traspaso. El catalán fue titular en los tres partidos en los que coincidió con Corberán (pasó más tiempo de central que de lateral), pero desde su marcha ha seguido el mismo camino que Sato. Ocho minutos con el interino Óscar y cuatro con Aguirre. Maffeo es titularísimo y sus opciones de jugar parecen muy pocas. El caso es que el mercado de verano dejó poca inversión y mal repartida. Los dos únicos jugadores por los que se ha pagado, han desaparecido del equipo con la destitución de Corberán tras la quinta jornada y los diez millones se han esfumado, algo parecido ya ocurrió temporadas atrás con Cenk, el central turco o con Marcos André, otra de las millonadas que se fueron por el desagüe.

articles.title: Celtic winger Jota 'met some demons' during long injury absence
articles.summary: Jota admits he "met some demons" during his long injury absence but believes there is no need to "rush" his return to full match fitness at Celtic.
articles.body:
Jota admits he "met some demons" during his long injury absence but believes there is no need to "rush" his return to full match fitness at Celtic.

The Portuguese winger, 27, sustained cruciate ligament damage in April 2025 and made his first-team return last weekend in the 2-0 win at Motherwell.

And, after coming off the bench again in Sunday's 7-1 Scottish Premiership victory at home to Hearts, Jota believes the ordeal has strengthened his character.

"I've met some demons and I've had some good talks with them," he said. "We developed a good relationship and we are all on the same table nowadays and we can laugh about everything that happened.

"If you don't grow from a situation like this, it's because you didn't learn anything.

"I could step away, see different things from other perspectives and value some stuff that maybe I wasn't valuing before.

"I have a clear idea of what I want, what I am. There's no lost time because I grew a lot. It had to be what it had to be and I didn't lose. I actually gained because I'm way stronger nowadays."

Hearts roll out red carpet ... and Celtic walk all over it

'Four points is nothing' - O'Neill stays cool after statement win

Jota's game time will be restricted to domestic games in the short term as he is not in Celtic's Europa League squad, with Celta Vigo visiting Glasgow on Thursday (20:00 BST).

However, he is valuing what playing opportunities he has.

"My love for football is immense," he explained. "Maybe someone else wouldn't want to come back because of the struggle or some guys just don't have that in themselves.

"That was my fuel to keep on working every day, to be healthy and fit, even if things weren't going that way.

"This is my dream. It's my passion. So there's moments where you reflect, there's moments where you're down and you cannot see any light but that doesn't mean that you stop believing. You just need to find another way.

"My aim was always to come back fit, whatever time I need to take because I still have a long career in front of me and I'm still young.

"So there's no rush, let's do everything correctly and just trust the process."

articles.title: El fútbol y sus casualidades: cuatro de los últimos entrenadores del Alba... han sido destituidos este mes
articles.standfirst: Alberto González, Rubén Albés, Rubén de la Barrera y Luis Miguel Ramis no siguen en sus banquillos
articles.summary: Alberto González, Rubén Albés, Rubén de la Barrera y Luis Miguel Ramis
articles.body: El Albacete Balompié atraviesa su peor arranque liguero y, en paralelo, vive un octubre negro que trasciende al Carlos Belmonte: cuatro de sus técnicos más recientes han perdido el banquillo, uno en el propio club y los otros tres en sus nuevos destinos. Parece que el mal inicio de Liga se ha extendido también a sus ex-entrenadores. Alberto González fue el primero en caer. El Albacete lo destituyó el 3 de octubre, tras la derrota en casa ante el Eibar (1-3) en la octava jornada, con el equipo como colista de LaLiga Hypermotion y un balance de un empate y siete derrotas en los primeros ocho partidos, un único punto de 24 posibles. El técnico de Tolox, llegado al club en marzo de 2024, dejó el banquillo albaceteño tras dirigir 108 partidos oficiales, lo que lo convertía en el entrenador más longevo de la categoría antes de su salida. Rubén Albés, al que Alberto González sucedió en el banquillo manchego, ha sido el último en sumarse a la lista. El Leganés anunció este domingo su destitución después de diez jornadas de LaLiga Hypermotion, con un balance de tres victorias, dos empates y cinco derrotas, tras encadenar cuatro derrotas consecutivas. Albés dirigió al Alba entre julio de 2022 y marzo de 2024, sumando 79 partidos oficiales al frente del conjunto del Carlos Belmonte blanco. Su etapa incluyó los playoffs de ascenso de la temporada 2022-23. Antes de la llegada de Albés el Alba ascendió a Segunda División tras una única temporada en Primera RFEF, y lo hizo de la mano de Rubén De la Barrera. El gallego culminó una gran temporada con el recordado 'Riazorazo', derrotando en la final por el ascenso a 'su' Dépor en Riazor con un histórico gol de Jordi Sánchez, ahora en el Pogon Szczecin polaco. De la Barrera dirigió 42 partidos oficiales al Alba, con veintidós victorias, diez empates y diez derrotas, antes de abandonar el banquillo en junio de 2022, apenas días después de conseguir el ascenso. Esta campaña, sin embargo, no ha tenido mejor suerte: la UD Las Palmas le destituyó el pasado 12 de octubre tras nueve jornadas, con tres victorias, dos empates y cuatro derrotas. El caso de Luis Miguel Ramis completa esta foto fija. El tarraconense entrenó al Albacete entre 2018 y 2020, con 72 partidos oficiales dirigidos, y llevó al equipo al playoff de ascenso en su primera temporada, aunque fue destituido en febrero de 2020 con el conjunto manchego en zona de descenso. Coincidiendo con De la Barrera, el pasado 12 de octubre Osasuna anunció que dejaba de ser entrenador rojillo después de ocho jornadas de LaLiga. Su balance fue de dos victorias, dos empates y cuatro derrotas. La coincidencia es llamativa: en menos de un mes, cuatro de los últimos entrenadores del Alba han perdido su puesto, ya que ninguno consiguió arrancar con solvencia su nuevo proyecto, incluido el primer inquilino del banquillo manchego de esta temporada. Mientras el Alba sigue hundido en la clasificación, ahora con Joseba Etxeberria en el banquillo, la casualidad ha vuelto a unir al Alba con algunos de sus exentrenadores más recientes.
